Artifact.Name: Talisman of the Wise Navigator
Artifact.Description: An extremely heavy wooden pendant on a silver chain meant to be worn around the neck. The pendant is in the shape of an early Ikkuro space vessel of the sort that would have been unable to travel beyond a solar system. These pendants were awarded to master craftsmen of the ancient Ikkuro shipwright guild, and they indicate its wearer has reached the pinnacle of knowledge in ship design and construction. Because of their great weight, these pendants were typically only worn on ceremonial occasions.
Artifact.ImageFilename: Artifacts/the talisman of the wise navigator

Artifact.Name: Orb of Thriving
Artifact.Description: An orb approximately the size of a grown Ikkuro’s skull, perfectly round, and made of a mysterious material unknown in modern times – possibly a sort of translucent aluminum. Within the orb is a cloud of swirling gases of different colors, interacting but never blending together. It is believed such orbs were used by the Ikkuro of the ancient galaxy as a meditation aid.

Artifact.Name: Tree of Creation
Artifact.Description: Inspired by an ancient Ikkuro creation myth, this hologram depicts a massive and almost impossibly tall tree with a gnarled trunk and innumerable branches lush with foliage and bearing large pieces of ripe fruit. Those who sit under the tree and contemplate a life of harmony and balance are said to be able to taste the fruit, which is alleged to be sweet and slightly sour.

Artifact.Name: The Book of Harmonious Necessity
Artifact.Description: This ancient codex comes from the Ikkuro homeworld and is said to predate space travel and possibly even atmospheric flying vessels. The author’s name has been lost to time, but the book was allegedly written by the ruler of an ancient nation-state and considers how war is sometimes necessary to further the cause of peace. So that peace can be achieved all the more rapidly, it provides much useful information on crushing the enemies of harmony.
